common_B_preconditions: AW accepted with stable parent_seq and AXI_ID
exact LEN+1 W handshakes, WLAST iff final beat, all payload and byte masks owned
all child transactions successfully sent exactly once; failed sends retry only unaccepted children
one B per parent, ID/order/VALID-held preserved

ack_options.meaning: private bridge owns all W data and timing work; DDR WR may not yet have issued
ack_options.remaining_debt: each accepted child must issue and reach model recovery maturity before final drain

ack_options.B_eligible: all common preconditions AND all parent children have actual final WR issue AND now>=max(child.WR_tick+nCWL+nBL)
ack_options.meaning: new private derived burst-end timing convention; no observed physical data completion
ack_options.remaining_debt: all write recovery maturity before final drain

deadlines.units: memory clock ticks; RTL/memory conversion must be frozen before run
deadlines.interval_convention: data interval [WR_tick+nCWL, WR_tick+nCWL+nBL); check now>=deadline at post-memory-tick
deadlines.recovery_is_not_actual_PRE: PRE/PREA may still have additional timing constraints; no forced close or nRP without actual PRE

granularity.mapping: per parent split actual bytes at 64B boundaries, one timing child per touched block; only send child after its relevant W beats are all accepted
granularity.aligned_full_block_child_count: (LEN+1)/8 when LEN+1 divisible by8 and AW aligned64
initial_exact_service_scope: 8B INCR confirmed by root actual call chain
granularity.other_traffic: record and reject exact service-model admission until separately specified with source-backed byte/RMW/ordering cost; do not silently ignore CPU/partial/narrow/atomic traffic

functional_store.existing_M0: write_beat at every W handshake; cb_q receives parent ID at final W; B handshake separate
functional_store.RAW_alias_policy: root must prove frozen traces avoid conflicting overlap or explicitly define full ordering/forwarding; Ramulator exact-address write_buffer forwarding alone insufficient

final_drain_all_required: no new injections; AW/W cardinality exact and all child work generated
accepted write child identities equal actual final WR identities exactly once
all read children completed and delivered
one B per parent, all B handshaken; all payload ownership/bridge queues/heldR/heldB empty
root functional natural completion and quiet hold
post full memory.tick: every controller read/write/active/priority/pending container empty
future actions empty, all banks nonRefreshing, refresh schedule consistently recorded per prior boundary card
now>=max(WR_tick+nCWL+nBL+nWR) across all accepted write children; empty set vacuous
no reset/clear state/forced write mode/dummy request/frozen refresh; timeout fails

passive_WR_hook.location: Generic controller after issue_command returns, before buffer.remove, conditional Write AND command==final_command==WR
passive_WR_hook.identity_proposal: new bridge may put stable immutable token pointer in existing Request.m_payload; validate unchanged selected scheduler/path behavior; never overload source_id
constraints: duplicate addresses never guessed by address alone

source_caveats.write_final_branch: TODO then remove; no write pending/depart/callback

default_watermarks.comparisons: strict >high*max or read_buffer empty enter; strict <low*max and read_buffer nonempty exit

source_caveats.small_finite_pure_writes: empty read_buffer forces write-mode selection when normal selection reached; no high-watermark-only deadlock proof, no general bounded fairness proof
source_caveats.buffer_capacity_caveat: max_size32, enqueue <= permits33; thresholds based on32

allowed_claims: source has accepted-write enqueue and observable actual final WR issue
two explicitly new private bridge completion conventions can be implemented subject to acceptance
derived write recovery tail extends queue-empty boundary
model timing results only after actual execution, clock contract and full drain acceptance
forbidden_claims: WR issue or empty containers imply data burst end or recovery completion
GEM5 response is actual AXI/MIG B
derived data_end measures real PHY/DQS/data commit
recovery deadline means row actually closed or ACT-ready
existing strobe-aware functional bytes prove precise partial/RMW timing
P/PN gain or direction ranking from this card
native sensor or application cost zero because a model hook can read it
necessary_negative_cases_not_executed: posted B before WR must not terminate whole run
data_end mature but recovery not mature
rejected send duplicated into accepted ledger
new or ongoing REF invalidates old drained snapshot
root_decision_inputs: validate actual AXI attributes, full physical traffic and all port payload scope
freeze mapping, ownership/backpressure and memory/RTL tick conversion
accept original-source ranges, proposed hook implementation and actual negative/passivity tests before run claims
